breakdown.description: Stokes' Law is valid only for Re < 1

The ground truth correctly identifies that Stokes' Law is only valid for Re < 1 and that a different method (experimental curves) is required.

breakdown.description: At Re = 10^5, flow is dominated by wake separation and inertia, not creeping viscosity
